ticker.name: Rainier Acquisition Corporation Class A Ordinary Shares

business_summary: Rainier Acquisition Corporation focuses on effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was formerly known as Chardan Healthcare Acquisition 4 Company and changed its name to Rainier Acquisition Corporation in March 2026. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is based in New York, New York.
business_summary_ko: Rainier Acquisition Corporation은 하나 이상의 기업과의 합병, 합병, 주식 교환, 자산 인수, 주식 매입, 재편성 또는 유사한 사업 결합을 수행하는 데 중점을 둡니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Chardan Healthcare Acquisition 4 Company로 알려졌으며 2026년 3월에 Rainier Acquisition Corporation으로 이름을 변경했습니다. 이 회사는 2023년에 법인화되었으며 뉴욕주 뉴욕에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
